name: Beiqi Foton Motor Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beiqi Foton Motor Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of complete vehicles in China and internationally. It operates through Vehicle and Other segments. The company offers mini, light, medium, and heavy trucks; light, medium, and large buses; vans and pickups; coaches; e-mobility products; used and special vehicles; new energy vehicles; automobile molds; and engines, gearboxes, batteries and electronic control systems, automobile driving systems, and other automotive parts and components.
